title: RBI Prudential Intermediary Lending & Acquisition Financing Norms
summary: RBI finalised acquisition financing framework: bank participation capped at 20% (up from 10%), total financing max 75% of acquisition value, debt-equity max 3:1, minimum net worth ₹500 Cr, effective April 1, 2026.

blocks.content: **Overview**: RBI finalised acquisition financing framework: bank participation capped at 20% (up from 10%), total financing max 75% of acquisition value, debt-equity max 3:1, minimum net worth ₹500 Cr, effective April 1, 2026.

items: **RBI finalises acquisition finance norms; caps overseas syndicated deal exposure at 20%** (Page 13): RBI finalised acquisition financing framework: bank participation capped at 20% (up from 10%), total financing max 75% of acquisition value, debt-equity max 3:1, minimum net worth ₹500 Cr, effective April 1, 2026.

**RBI mandates 100% collateral for stockbroker credit facilities** (Page 14): RBI Commercial Banks Credit Facilities Directions 2026: Broker funding must be 100% fully secured; bank guarantees backed by min 50% collateral (25% cash) with 40% haircut on shares from April 1, 2026.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Bank Capital Market Exposure & Corporate Financing. Mandatory 100% secured broker credit, 40% equity haircut, and 20% acquisition financing cap.
